mapper.select: SELECT id AS value, shift_name AS label, shift_type AS type, color, CONCAT(shift_name, ' (', start_time, '-', end_time, ')') AS displayName FROM jsh_schedule_shift WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND is_active = 1 AND ifnull(delete_flag,'0') != '1' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.color, COUNT(a.id) AS assignmentCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM jsh_schedule_shift s LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_assignment a ON s.id = a.shift_id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' AND a.schedule_date BETWEEN #{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' GROUP BY s.id, s.shift_name, s.shift_type, s.color ORDER BY assignmentCount DESC, s.sort_order ASC

SELECT s.id, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.color, COUNT(a.id) AS usageCount, ROUND(COUNT(a.id) * 100.0 / total.total_assignments, 2) AS usagePercentage FROM jsh_schedule_shift s LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_assignment a ON s.id = a.shift_id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_assignments FROM jsh_schedule_assignment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(delete_flag,'0') != '1' ) total WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' GROUP BY s.id, s.shift_name, s.shift_type, s.color, total.total_assignments ORDER BY usageCount DESC
LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT s.id, s.shift_name AS shiftName, s.shift_type AS shiftType, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.duration_hours AS durationHours, s.is_active AS isActive, s.sort_order AS sortOrder, s.description, s.color, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime, COUNT(a.id) AS totalAssignments, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS uniqueUsers, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedAssignments, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 END) AS cancelledAssignments FROM jsh_schedule_shift s LEFT JOIN jsh_schedule_assignment a ON s.id = a.shift_id AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(a.delete_flag,'0') != '1' WHERE s.id = #{shiftId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND s.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(s.delete_flag,'0') != '1' GROUP BY s.id, s.shift_name, s.shift_type, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.duration_hours, s.is_active, s.sort_order, s.description, s.color, s.create_time, s.update_time

SELECT id, shift_name, shift_type, start_time, end_time, duration_hours, is_active, sort_order, description, color, tenant_id, delete_flag, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM jsh_schedule_shift WHERE shift_type = #{shiftType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(delete_flag,'0') != '1' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM jsh_schedule_shift WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ifnull(delete_flag,'0') != '1'
